hash_conventions.canonical_json_sha256: SHA256(UTF-8 json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False)); this is the prepare_panel canonical_json/json_sha256 convention used for exchange aggregates
hash_conventions.fit_replay_supplied_hash: fit replay opaque_record_id_order_sha256 is copied from the existing P04 selection ledger and checked against the linked replay metadata record order; its individual rendered_sha256 values are emitted when present, while missing P04 sequence fields are explicit unavailable markers
hash_conventions.metadata_json_file_serialization: P04 metadata ledgers are written with json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) and a final LF; their file SHA256 descriptors hash those exact UTF-8 bytes

opaque_fields.public_record_fingerprint: metadata public_record_sha256; an opaque SHA256 string, emitted only as ordered/set values
opaque_fields.record_id: metadata record_id; treated as an opaque string and never emitted per record
opaque_fields.truncated_sequence_fingerprint: metadata truncated_sequence_sha256; an opaque SHA256 string, emitted only as ordered/set values

hash_conventions.ordered_opaque_value_sha256: SHA256 of each declared opaque UTF-8 string followed by LF, in ledger order, including the final LF; this is prepare_panel.digest_lines and public_activation.record_ids_sha256
hash_conventions.ordered_pair_sha256: Each emitted ordered pair digest is SHA256 of canonical JSON {'public_record_sha256': value, 'truncated_sequence_sha256': value} using the exchange canonical JSON convention; the ordered arrays retain the original row pairing

public_text_fingerprint_generation.alpaca_instruction:
instruction/input/output values convert null to empty text; user is instruction plus optional '

' plus input, capped at 1200 characters, output is capped at 1200 characters; render tokenizer.apply_chat_template([{'role':'user','content':user}], tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) plus output, then SHA256 rendered UTF-8 bytes
public_text_fingerprint_generation.finance_chat:
system/user/assistant values convert null to empty text and are stripped; missing user falls back to stripped instruction plus optional '

' plus stripped input, and missing assistant falls back to stripped output; hash compact JSON [system-or-null,user,assistant] with ensure_ascii=False and separators=(',', ':') as UTF-8
public_text_fingerprint_generation.pile_plain: SHA256(raw text UTF-8 bytes); _text_value converts null to empty text and performs no trim or Unicode normalization

sequence_fingerprint_generation.binary_encoding: SHA256(struct.pack('<' + 'i'*N, *(int(value) for value in values))); no JSON wrapper and no dtype conversion beyond signed int32 representability
sequence_fingerprint_generation.public_panel: token IDs are produced with add_special_tokens=False, include the declared BOS at index zero, and hash token_ids[:1+128] (BOS plus at most 128 post-BOS IDs)
sequence_fingerprint_generation.target_update_audit: the target preparation helper uses the same little-endian signed-int32 packing convention; no target per-record sequence values are serialized into this exchange

hash_conventions.targetfit_supplied_hashes: target row-order, selection, plan, and target-update artifact SHA256 values are copied from existing P04 audit/receipt metadata; per-record target public/sequence arrays are explicitly unavailable and the target-update tensor is not opened here
hash_conventions.tensor_sha256: For tensor digests used by P04 runtime assets: detach().cpu().contiguous(), prefix UTF-8 compact sorted JSON {'dtype': str(tensor.dtype), 'shape': list(tensor.shape)}, then append exact contiguous CPU bytes from view(torch.uint8).numpy().tobytes(order='C')
hash_conventions.unique_set_canonical_json_sha256: SHA256 of canonical JSON for the sorted unique opaque-string set

producer.input_scope: P04 metadata ledgers and the linked immutable replay record-metadata ledger listed below; no observation, source, truth, model-weight, or target-update payload was opened
